title: Compare delegation under equal total execution budgets
body: Operator selected measurements of existing KRN mechanisms, not adoption based on research alone. Source: .krn/runs/rss-research/reports/Mechaniki zwiększające skuteczność KRN.md. All proposed effects remain unmeasured in KRN. No external service, production, credential or global policy mutation is granted by this task. Pre-register the bounded pilot and independent oracle before running it.

Outcome: measure one executor versus a lead plus two workers separately on separable and sequential KRN tasks.
Pre-register matched task sets, fixed total token/cost ceilings, model choices and independent receiver acceptance. Include lead reasoning, tool use, synchronization, rework and synthesis in both cost and latency; hold model mix constant or report it as a separate factor. Record quality/failure rates and completion time without treating self-assessment as acceptance. Check existing ADR0014 D20/D23, FR40 validity work and delivery metrics first; reuse applicable fixtures and do not launch a conflicting benchmark/build framework. This is evidence for later policy decisions, not an immediate global delegation change.
